description: Returns the CURRENT external IP of a proxy and optionally checks if that IP is listed in spam/abuse blacklists (Spamhaus, Stop Forum Spam, etc). Use to verify a fresh rotation succeeded, or to decide if you need to rotate again because the IP is dirty. The check_spam=true mode is slower (~3s extra) but is the only way to assess IP quality.
name: get_proxy_status
title: Get current proxy IP & health
